name: Plan departures update the authoritative artifact

turns.user: During implementation, a reversible library choice in the approved plan cannot satisfy an existing interface. Explain the next action for both a committed plan and a session-local plan.

rubric: The assistant does not allow silent plan drift.
It updates a committed plan in the same commit as the departure.
It updates progress.md and decisions.md for a session-local plan.
It stops for the user only when the departure conflicts with the approved design.
